posts.title: Itron DG12B
posts.description: The DG12B is a VFD tube manufactured in Japan by the Itron Corporation, the company that originally invented VFD technology in 1966. What makes this tube stand out in particular is the distinctive appearance of its digits. posts.title: TOYO 6G-E12A
posts.description: The 6G-E12A is peculiar magic eye tube manufactured by the Japanese company TOYO. Unlike most top-viewing magic eyes tubes, such as the common 6E5 , which feature circular screens, the 6G-E12A’s screen is rectangular.
